sources.title: Architecture graph for OrionLLM/GRM-3.2-Turf. - hfviewer
sources.snippet: OrionLLM/GRM-3.2-Turf is an image-text-to-text model (lfm2 architecture). It uses 16 transformer layers, a hidden size of 2,048, and 32 query heads with 8 key/value heads (grouped-query attention).
